name: rh.webapp.txt2img.zimage_art_portrait.v1
description: Z-image 4K art portrait photography webapp. Single text prompt. Default style is Rembrandt-lit dreamy film photography; rewriting the prompt can produce character three-view (front/side/back) sheets.

required.name: prompt_text
required.description: Full text prompt. Replaces the default art-portrait style. For a three-view character sheet, explicitly request 三视图/正面/侧面/背面/并排/白底.
